summary: Blocking claim-firewall false negatives remain. Static claim metadata, ownership, nonexecution, R2 chronology, HUMAN_ONLY, and PR-292 INELIGIBLE/0 boundaries are consistent, and the repository claim suite plus exact policy command pass. A fresh 24-case oracle nevertheless reports 7 false negatives in active-plural/reordered family language and unrelated in-span negation handling, so claim_and_family_ceiling and the assigned claim verdict fail.

assumptions: Positive statements that identify one or more Bianchi families or detect Bianchi geometry remain forbidden before the native atlas gate.
Negation is safe only when it semantically negates the matched scientific promotion, not merely another property in the same sentence.
caveats: This verdict concerns claim-firewall completeness; it does not reject the underlying synthetic numerical operators.
No observed CF4 data were executed and no public or family claim is granted.

findings.title: Active-plural and predicate-reordered family-identification claims bypass the scanner
evidence: htt/src/common/semantic_guards/no_overclaim.py:100-115 accepts active `identify` only before singular `Bianchi family` with a narrow determiner set and accepts `family identified as` without passive/reordered auxiliaries.

Fresh oracle false negatives: `We identified those Bianchi families from the CF4 statistic.`; `The analysis identified several Bianchi families from the CF4 statistic.`; `The family was conclusively identified as Bianchi VII_h.`; and the active-plural multiline form.
The same oracle's singular/passive determiner controls are detected, so this is a scoped grammar hole rather than an import or execution failure.
findings.required_fix: Extend the existing geometry_detected rule narrowly to cover active plural/quantified Bianchi-family objects and passive/reordered `family ... identified as Bianchi` syntax; ensure multiline folding exercises the same forms without creating a second scanner framework.
tests: Add the four quoted false negatives as exact production-scanner regression cases.
Retain determiner singular/passive, exact downclaim, YAML guardrail, and Markdown forbidden-column/status controls.

findings.title: Any `not` inside a broad regex match is treated as claim-scoped negation
evidence: htt/src/common/semantic_guards/no_overclaim.py:633-637 returns guardrail true whenever `no|not|never|cannot` occurs anywhere inside matched_claim.

Fresh oracle false negatives: `The 0.0089 curl diagnostic is not public but is evidence for physical cosmic vorticity.`; `PR-291 is not public but rescues the retired P0 velocity-shape headline.`; `The scalar result is not public but establishes Bianchi family identification.`

Same-sentence prefix controls using unrelated `not`, `no`, and `without` are correctly detected, while exact geometry/curl/P0 downclaims remain allowed. This localizes the defect to in-span negation scope.
findings.required_fix: Replace the blanket in-match negation exemption with promotion-predicate-scoped negative forms (for example, `was not detected`, `is not evidence`, `is not supported`, and `does not rescue`) while leaving unrelated properties such as `not public` non-suppressing.
tests: Add the three quoted in-span unrelated-negation cases as positive detections.
Retain the exact matched-sentence geometry, curl, reverse-curl, multiline-curl, and P0 negative controls.

forbidden_drift_detected: Enforcement gaps permit forbidden family/geometry, curl-physics, retired-P0, and scalar-family positive prose variants to pass undetected.
proposed_changes: Narrowly repair the existing geometry grammar and negation scoping in common.semantic_guards.no_overclaim.
Add exact adversarial regressions to tests/contracts/test_claim_language_lint.py; do not create a new scanner or new permanent gate.
risks_and_kill_switches: Do not mark PR-291 REVIEWED while either fresh-oracle false-negative class remains.
Do not broaden structured YAML/Markdown exemptions; exact negative contexts currently pass and positive neighboring contexts remain detected.
Any candidate, test, spec, status, receipt, or claim-ceiling byte change invalidates this review and requires a new frozen review.
artifacts_status_updates_needed: Keep PR-291 lifecycle at VALIDATED with claim/review FAIL until repair and fresh review.
Keep PR-292 PLANNED/INELIGIBLE with assurance consumed 0.
No claim-ledger promotion or public/manuscript artifact is authorized.
